messages:
Priya: Hi team — starting onboarding for LunarBridge (acct: lunarbridge.ai). Objective: get two product flows live in prod sandbox and a 30-day pilot with measurable KPIs. Owners: Priya (CS), Ethan (SE), Diego (Platform). Need to align stakeholders, critical success metrics, and a short timeline.
Ethan: Quick infra notes: they require private endpoints + audit logs. Can we do a sandbox VPC peering and scoped API keys?
Diego: Yes — sandbox peering + scoped keys OK. ETA: infra tasks done in 6 business days if customer network team is responsive.
Marta: From CS: success criteria proposed — 1) 95th pct gen latency < 1s for 512 tokens, 2) embedding recall >= 0.85 on their test set, 3) audit logs delivered to their Splunk instance, 4) two workflow toggles used by product by pilot end. Renewal sensitivity: low NPS or missing audit evidence increases risk.
Priya: Good list. I'll capture the metrics and make a simple dashboard. @Ethan can you confirm model variant for pilot (redwood-bert-qa-v1 or Llama hybrid)?
Ethan: Recommend redwood-bert-qa-v1 for initial QA flows, switch to Llama hybrid for bulk generation if latency ok. I'll test both on similar payloads.
onboard-bot: Kickoff created: /kickoffs/lunarbridge-2998881111  owners: Priya, Ethan, Diego
Diego: Risk note: customer IdP has strict certificate rotation policy. Ask them to share rotation window. Action: Priya to collect.
Marta: Enablement plan: 1) Tech integration workshop (devs) - 60m 2) Admin / Ops runbook session (platform ops) - 45m 3) 10-min executive demo at EoP. Also propose a 6-question feedback pulse at day 14.
Priya: I'll schedule two blocks next week: Wed 10am PT (dev workshop) + Fri 11am PT (ops runbook). Sending calendar invites to LunarBridge Eng lead and SecOps.
Ethan: For QA, I'll prepare a small harness with sample prompts and an embedding eval set. Will post results in this thread.
Diego: I'll open the VPC peering request and enable prefix caching + short-term dedupe rules to reduce token spend during pilot.
Marta: Suggest tracking these KPIs: queries/day, pct success (end-to-end), avg token cost, embedding recall. Set an escalation if queries/day < 100 on day 10.
Priya: :thumbsup: Adding KPIs to kickoff doc. Any blockers?
Ethan: Waiting on customer to provide network CIDR and IdP cert window. Once we have that, infra can move fast.
Priya: I'll ping their SecOps after this thread. Plan: share kickoff notes, intake form, and calendar invites by EOD. Thanks all.
